mentions.name: BranchBay Git client
mentions.description: A Rust-native Git GUI client, one of two interconnected apps on branchbay.dev, built as a subscription-free alternative to GitKraken for developers.
mentions.problem: Developers pay for GitKraken subscriptions and lack a native alternative without recurring fees.
mentions.audience: Developers currently paying for GitKraken subscriptions
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been trying to get developers off Gitkraken and Termius subscriptions by building 2 Rust native interconnected apps.

You can check them out at: https://branchbay.dev
